summary_en: Tamai Steamship will cancel 200,000 shares (10.35% of outstanding shares before cancellation) on November 30, 2026, reducing issued share capital from 1,932,030 to 1,732,000 shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On November 4, 2026, Tamai Steamship's Board of Directors resolved to cancel 200,000 treasury shares held by the company, effective November 30, 2026. The shares to be cancelled represent 10.35% of the company's issued share capital prior to cancellation. Following the cancellation, the total number of issued shares will decrease from 1,932,030 to 1,732,000 shares, while treasury stock on hand will remain at 202,030 shares. The cancellation is executed in accordance with Article 178 of the Companies Act of Japan.
